Updates `zizmorcore/zizmor-action` from 0.6.4 to 0.7.1
Release notes

Sourced from zizmorcore/zizmor-action's releases.

v0.7.1

zizmor changes

Bug Fixes 🐛🔗

  • Fixed a regression in 1.31.0 where some ignore comments/configurations would no longer apply to the dangerous-triggers audit

action changes

The default version of zizmor is now 1.31.1.

What's Changed

  • Sync zizmor versions by @​github-actions[bot] in zizmorcore/zizmor-action#178

Full Changelog: https://github.com/zizmorcore/zizmor-action/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1

v0.7.0

Sponsorship is appreciated!

zizmor notes

Enhancements 🌱🔗

  • The typosquat-uses audit now supports pre-commit config inputs (#2437)

  • The self-hosted-runner audit is now significantly more precise (#2350)

    Many thanks to @​ubiratansoares for proposing and implementing this enhancement!

  • The dangerous-triggers audit now considers the issue_comment trigger fundamentally dangerous (#2396)

  • zizmor is now aware of the image_version workflow trigger (#2397)

  • The dangerous-triggers audit now produces more precise finding/diagnostic spans (#2402)

  • The cache-poisoning audit is now aware of pnpm/setup (#2409)

  • The unpinned-images audit now produces more precise findings when the user's workflow contains an indirect matrix (#2395)

    Many thanks to @​ubiratansoares for proposing and implementing this enhancement!

  • The cache-poisoning audit is now aware of GitHub's new cache-mode: setting, and will skip any findings that would occur when a job has an effective cache-mode: none (#2418)

  • The cache-poisoning audit now flags usages of cache-mode: write and cache-mode: write-only with dangerous triggers, i.e. triggers that give an attacker privileged code execution (#2426)

  • zizmor now uses a tree-sitter grammar for PowerShell that's more precise/capable of capturing more non-trivial PowerShell expressions (#2444)

Bug Fixes 🐛🔗
